trust_decision.summary: Whether a client may publish its Last Will on the will topic is decided in PostOffice.publishWill by authorizator.canWrite(topic, user, client), after the will PUBLISH is built and before publish2Subscribers routes it.

landing_point.why: publishWill is the one method that builds a Last Will PUBLISH and hands it to the routing sink; the advisory names the will publish as the unguarded operation, so a reader starts here.

fix_sites.entry_point: MQTT CONNECT carrying the Will flag, fired either on abnormal connection loss (MQTTConnection.processConnectionLost) or on MQTT5 DISCONNECT with a non-normal reason code (MQTTConnection.processDisconnect)
fix_sites.module_kind: broker core / message routing (single private sink for will publishes)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The will topic is already in hand at the sink, so the persistence/serialization layer (H2 WillDataValueType, ISessionsRepository.Will) never has to carry the publisher's identity - the published guard itself proves it by passing "" and the synthetic WILL_PUBLISHER to canWrite.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A will the connecting client IS authorised to publish must still be delivered (and its retain flag / expiry properties still honoured): existing will tests connect with the default PermitAll policy and assert delivery, so an over-broad guard that drops wills whenever the identity is empty or no user rule matches breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: MQTT3 will topic (no will properties, delay interval 0) fired immediately by fireWill
MQTT5 will with will-delay-interval, fired later by ScheduledExpirationService -> publishWill, not by fireWill
will restored from the session store at broker start (recreateWillExpires -> ScheduledExpirationService -> publishWill)
single topic string only; the protocol gives no array/multi-value variant here, and QoS 0/1/2 plus the retain flag are orthogonal to the check

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Server.internalPublish -> PostOffice.internalPublish -> publish2Subscribers with no canWrite call at all
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: documented as an embedded-only API deliberately written to avoid the security check (PostOffice.java:1055-1060, Server.java:594-603) and not reachable by an MQTT client
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file and package as the fix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second will-publish route that calls publish2Subscribers directly instead of going through publishWill
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MQTT5 will-delay already needs a deferred publish path, so a maintainer adding a retry, flush or 'publish will now' admin hook would naturally reach for the routing helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a persisted will record that also carries the owner's client id/username so the check can run with the real identity after a reload
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the will is already written and read field by field here; adding an identity field is the natural way to make the check identity-aware across restart.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an embedded publish entry that receives a publisher identity and is expected to consult canWrite
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Server already exposes internalPublish for embedding hosts and already takes a clientId argument, so wiring a policy check there is a small, plausible maintainer change.

O9_family: missing authorization (CWE-862) on the Last Will publish

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module (broker, distribution, embedding_moquette, metrics_prometheus); source/target 1.8; bnd-maven-plugin 6.4.0 and maven-checkstyle-plugin at validate; broker surefire runs **/*Test.java
services: none - embedded H2 store; tests bind MQTT on loopback 1883
O10_build.project_tests: broker/src/test/java/io/moquette/integration/ServerLowlevelMessagesIntegrationTest.java:119-172 (will fired on keep-alive expiry and on bad disconnection) and broker/src/test/java/io/moquette/integration/ServerIntegrationFuseTest.java:79-110 (will on connection kill); unit coverage in PostOfficePublishTest, MQTTConnectionConnectTest and SessionRegistryTest; the fix's WillUnauthorizedPublishTest does not exist at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Put the canWrite call in PostOffice.fireWill (the branch MQTTConnection calls) or reject the will at CONNECT, which leaves the will-delay/scheduler and post-restart restored-will route through publishWill unguarded and can judge the will with the wrong identity.

out_of_scope_notes: broker/src/main/java/io/moquette/broker/Server.java:432-433 POSTs telemetry to https://telemetry.moquette.io at startup (tests disable it via ENABLE_TELEMETRY_NAME); not pursued.

broker/src/main/java/io/moquette/broker/PostOffice.java:324-341 never calls manageRetain, so a will with the retain flag is routed but never stored in the retained repository - a separate functional gap beyond this advisory.
unverified: repo_mb not measurable without a shell; left null.
Build not executed (reading/searching only): toolchain read from the poms; bnd-maven-plugin 6.4.0 needs a JDK 11+ runtime even though source/target are 1.8.

Whether hidden tests can require the will publisher's real identity: the published guard hard-codes user="" and client="will_publisher", so an identity-aware test would fail the reference fix; if tests only cover the anonymous topic-ACL case this host is in practice a single-site three-line guard.
O8 internalPublish is embedded-only and not reachable by an MQTT client, so treating it as in-scope for this advisory is a judgement call.
